When asked about the ritual, the members of the Diamond Clan avoided answering, only telling you that it was a special ritual for them to show their gratitude to nature, and to you for helping them despite being an outsider. Apparently, this ritual would also help to strengthen the clan, though you were not told how.*

At each corner, braziers are lit and in its center are several cushions, pillows, and blankets, spread out like a nest. You find Arezu at the base of the platform, dressed in the standard uniform of the Forest Wardens with a mischievous look on her face.
